title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
notes: Entered into force 2024-08-01. The Article 50 transparency obligations apply from 2026-08-02 (24 months after entry into force); the Instrument-level effective date is entry into force, while provision-level application phases in. issuedBy is the co-legislators (European Parliament and Council), adopted under the ordinary legislative procedure.
